chapters.reason: The paper proposes modeling discrete data as continuous 'analog bits' and applying diffusion models to these continuous representations, which aligns with embedding-based diffusion.
The paper focuses on generating discrete data (tokens), which is the primary objective of masked diffusion models, even though the specific implementation uses continuous diffusion.

The paper compares its performance against autoregressive models and discusses its application to tasks like image captioning where autoregressive models are standard, touching on the hybrid nature of discrete generation.
